update_log: Baseline Initialization of Major Government Schemes and Initiatives for the 2026 Exam Cycle.

schemes.scheme_name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
schemes.core_objective: Provide up to 300 units of free electricity every month through rooftop solar setups.

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Unnat Gram Abhiyan
schemes.core_objective: Comprehensive development and saturation of basic facilities in tribal-majority villages.

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
schemes.core_objective: End-to-end support, skill enhancement, and credit access for traditional artisans and craftspeople.

schemes.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.core_objective: Provide health coverage of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization. (Recently expanded to all citizens aged 70+).

schemes.scheme_name: PM Schools for Rising India (PM SHRI)
schemes.core_objective: Upgrade and develop existing schools into model schools aligned with National Education Policy (NEP) 2020.

schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.core_objective: Provide income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments to landholding farmer families.
